cohort: 3161 women undergoing in vitro fertilization-embryo transfer cycles, with 1009 in the fresh embryo transfer group and 2152 in the frozen embryo transfer group.
finding: Frozen embryo transfer was associated with a higher risk of abortion, early abortion, large for gestational age infant, macrosomia, cesarean section, and pregnancy-induced hypertension, as well as increased birth weight.
mod_finding: Frozen embryo transfer was associated with a higher risk of cesarean section.
gest_age: Frozen embryo transfer was associated with increased gestational age at delivery.
birth_weight: Frozen embryo transfer was associated with increased birth weight.
